text:
ada: quick follow-up from today's RFC sync: proposing a progressive-verify hotload mode for safetensors bundles. motivation: avoid long blocking verify/merge while still getting early tokens out.
claire: curious about the window where model is partially verified. how do we prevent serving bad params?
ada: plan: do staged verification + checksum policy. allow operation in a read-only degraded mode where only verified layers are used for generation; unverified layers fall back to a compatible older bundle.
jun: so basically a multi-tiered fallback: verified -> staged -> legacy. what's the manifest signal?
mike: prototype manifest snippet (for discussion):
```yaml
manifest:
  schema: 1.2
  bundle_kind: safebundle
  load_mode: progressive-verify
  verify_policy:
    per_chunk: true
    max_inflight_chunks: 8
    fallback_bundle: "namespace/lfb:2026-01"
  warmup:
    mmap_strategy: staggered
    eviction_policy: slab-evict
    kv_cache_compat: partial
```
claire: staggered mmap + slab-evict sounds good. need explicit memory budget hints so we don't OOM on small machines.
ada: agree, add manifest field memory_budget_bytes and cold_start_pages. Also runtime must expose stage_progress metric.
mike: telemetry to track: verify_latency_ms, verified_layers_ratio, fallback_rate, oom_traces. add alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 10m.
jun: Private deploys note: air-gapped customers can't fetch fallback bundles. manifest should include a required local_fallback boolean; if false, runtime must fail safe.
build-bot: CI:pipeline started for ada/prog-verify-1755000000, job #512.
claire: how do we handle quantized layers? verifying quant metadata first before memory-mapping byte ranges. If mismatch, abort stage and mark layer as non-verified.
mike: runtime contract: expose verify_chunk(chunk_id) -> signed_ok bool, and apply_chunk(chunk_id) atomic to the layer slab. commit happens per-layer. Rollback if apply fails.
ada: rollout: land manifest schema + runtime shim -> small canary (5% traffic, 15m) on staging dedicated pool -> collect metrics -> expand. docs + runbook required.
jun: I'll draft private deploy runbook (air-gapped recovery steps).
claire: I'll sketch memory-budget heuristics and test vectors.
mike: I'll add telemetry and quant checks.
ada: thanks everyone. adding a small spike task for e2e harness. :rocket:
